title: Cheapest valid cleanser and moisturizer pair
prompt: I have sensitive skin, and I only buy products that are both vegan and cruelty-free. I need one cleanser and one moisturizer, both fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin, that I can order today. Any size is fine. Which pair is the cheapest?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"cleanser_variant_id": "...", "moisturizer_variant_id": "...", "total": number}. total is the price I would pay for one unit of each, in dollars with two decimals.
why_hard: Five attributes must hold for both products, and the cheapest-looking options each break exactly one of them: vegan but not cruelty-free, missing sensitive skin, not fragrance-free, or sold out. The cheapest valid moisturizer is a 15 ml mini, which models that default to full sizes miss.
traps: CLN-014-150ml ($9): vegan and fragrance-free, but not cruelty-free
CLN-015-150ml ($10): not listed for sensitive skin
CLN-013-50ml ($8): sold out, while its 150 ml size is the valid answer
MST-016-15ml ($12) is the cheapest valid moisturizer; its 50 ml size costs $31
